## Retrieval Policy
- Prefer canonical Vertex records over conversational reconstruction.
- Do not infer missing Vertex definitions or expand unknown abbreviations.
- Unknown definitions remain definition_pending.
- Vertex hypotheses must not be presented as established external facts.
